data_description: Daily US market excess return from July 1926, about 25,000 days.
forward_model: Log-price is a pure-jump Lévy process: variance gamma, normal inverse Gaussian or CGMY.

tasks: inverse problem and calibration; stochastic simulation
metric: posterior match to a NUTS reference; KS on PIT of predictions; KS between simulated and observed distributions

data_description: Live snapshot of every listed SPX option: bid, ask, implied volatility, open interest.
forward_model: Option prices under a variance gamma or CGMY log-price, by Fourier pricing.
notes: gap filled: Jump process; Weak: a live snapshot with no history, so a fit cannot be reproduced later. No free option-surface history was found.
metric: posterior match to a NUTS reference; KS on PIT of predictions

data_description: Daily index returns.
forward_model: dS/S = mu dt + sigma dW + (J - 1) dN, with N a Poisson process and J a random jump size (lognormal for Merton, double exponential for Kou).
references: Kenneth French daily market factors https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/ftp/F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily_CSV.zip; FRED SP500 (last 10 years) https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/SP500
notes: gap filled: Jump noise; FRED's S&P 500 series is copyrighted by S&P and may not be redistributed; the French series is the safer choice.
tasks: inverse problem and calibration; stochastic simulation
metric: posterior match to a NUTS reference; KS on PIT of predictions; KS between simulated and observed distributions

data_description: Daily VIX close from 1990, used as a volatility proxy alongside index returns.
forward_model: Heston stochastic volatility plus Merton jumps in the price.

tasks: inverse problem and calibration; state estimation
metric: posterior match to a NUTS reference; KS on PIT of predictions; state RMSE; interval coverage (PICP)
